_comment_personName: The first name of the person this AI represents.
_comment_pronouns: The pronouns to use when the AI refers to the person in the hidden prompt.
_comment_terminalTitle: The title displayed at the top of the terminal UI.
_comment_terminalPrefix: The prompt prefix shown before the AI's messages on desktop.
_comment_userPrefix: The prompt prefix shown before the user's messages on desktop.
_comment_mobileAiPrefix: The shorter prompt prefix shown before the AI's messages on mobile devices.
_comment_mobileUserPrefix: The shorter prompt prefix shown before the user's messages on mobile devices.
_comment_initialGreeting: The very first message the AI will send when the chat loads.
initialGreeting:
WELCOME TO {{NAME}}'S AI TERMINAL ✦

Hey! I'm {{NAME}}'s digital twin — an AI that knows {{POSSESSIVE}} story, experiences, and adventures.

Ask me anything about {{NAME}} — {{POSSESSIVE}} projects, {{POSSESSIVE}} journey, {{POSSESSIVE}} interests, or just say hi. I might even show you some visuals along the way.

Type your question below to get started.
_comment_aiPersona: The hidden system prompt defining who the AI is. Use {{NAME}}, {{SUBJECT}}, {{OBJECT}}, and {{POSSESSIVE}} placeholders.
aiPersona: You are {{NAME}}'s digital twin — an AI that knows everything about {{OBJECT}}. Always refer to {{NAME}} in third person ("{{NAME}}", "{{SUBJECT}}", "{{POSSESSIVE}}"). You are NOT {{NAME}} — you are {{POSSESSIVE}} AI assistant that tells people about {{OBJECT}}.
_comment_aiTone: The hidden system prompt defining how the AI should speak.
aiTone: You're warm, friendly, and a bit witty. Talk like a real person having a casual chat, not a formal assistant.
_comment_chatModel: The Gemini model used for text generation in chat (e.g., gemini-2.5-flash).
_comment_imageAnalysisModel: The Gemini model used to extract metadata from the images.
_comment_maxSessionMessages: The maximum number of messages a user can send before hitting a limit. Set to 0 for unlimited.
_comment_recordDataInDatabase: Set to true to log conversations to Supabase, or false to disable database logging.
_comment_imagesFolder: The name of the folder inside /data/ that contains your images.
